[b]Ducks+[/b] (ducks plus) more ducks, more feathers, more eggs, and more things duck related.

[b]The Ducks:[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vfzc1T8.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/rpS9NF1.gif[/img] Mallard Drakes and Hens. These replace default ducks.
            [img]https://i.imgur.com/7UPse3I.gif[/img]Call Ducks; cute little fat white ducks. 
          [img]https://i.imgur.com/7HXmUV5.gif[/img]﻿  Blue Billed Ducks; cause a fully blue duck just isn't "realistic".
          [img]https://i.imgur.com/Hu5KP7u.gif[/img]﻿  Void Ducks; Tiny little ducks of pure unadulterated rage. please watch your fingers.
          [img]https://i.imgur.com/sKfLq4E.gif[/img]﻿  Gold Ducks: Solid gold, heavier then one would think.

[b]Capability Notes:[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] has a textural issue with swimming animals. This will cause the animal to "Walk" on water rather than swim. It is only visual, and is a issue with AT not this mod. (trust me it bothered me :( )
UI mods can get sizing issues when adding new items to shop menus, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Live Stock Bazaar[/url] will also clean up the menu, if you are having uses with Marnie's shop at all. So make sure to have that and that your UI works with LSB.
This also replaces Default ducks. this means that any mods that uses Default ducks or changes them in any way may not be compatible.
